title: Work Item lifecycle timing model
outOfScope: Provider polling, human wait measurement, scheduler/retry behavior, verification-evidence reuse, impact routing, release, tags, and external analytics.

riskAssessment.reason: Timing evidence must never misstate unavailable provider or human wait as measured local execution.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The bounded local timing work has source, tests, and explicit authorization.

preReviewWarnings: Review unknown timing claims and phase-pair integrity.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Source-bound local phase timing pairs planning, preflight, implementation, verification, finish, and closure without a negative duration or duplicate unmatched phase.
Active local compute is reported separately from provider and human wait, which remain unknown without authoritative evidence.
Repeated execution count and cache outcome are represented deterministically, including no-claim behavior when no timing evidence exists.
Focused/full timing tests, required governance checks, archive, PR, merge, and ai-close-work-item have recorded evidence.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The V0.5 lifecycle records command facts but cannot give a source-bound account of phase elapsed time, repeated execution, cache result, or unmeasured provider/human wait.
constraints: Capture only deterministic local command boundaries.
Provider and human wait are unknown unless authoritative evidence supplies them.
Paired phases must be integrity-checked and no duration claim may be emitted without matching evidence.
The recorded user approval is limited to this Work Item PR, merge, and governed cleanup.
intent.rationale: A local phase ledger makes planning evidence inspectable while retaining explicit uncertainty for external waits.

declaredIntent.summary: Implement Task 7 source-bound local lifecycle timing and then independently archive, PR, merge, and close it.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A phase end has no matching start or would create a negative duration.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The timing record is rejected or remains unknown.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Provider or human wait has no authoritative source.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No elapsed-time claim is emitted for that wait.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The same phase is executed repeatedly with cache outcomes.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Counts and cache results stay deterministic.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
